svg.title: The lifted trial columns are jEπiej,i and have exactly the same response entries as the original projected trials. Hence all three error allowances and the explicit stable inverse are recovered on the same columns. Equation-kernel recovery remains ker bπi = p−1 E (ker πi); section composition returns the identified equation ideal. This transports rank, detector constants and the ordered training/probe/mesh choices while distinguishing coefficient projection from the gauge-field read- out.
